name: Kitawolf Unregistered Tag Cleanup
author: kitawolfstudios

sections.description:
Kitawolf Unregistered Tag Cleanup provides a complete manual cleanup workflow without scan, result, suppression, whitelist, or cleanup limits.

Free features

  • Batched scans of posts, pages, and public custom post types.
  • Affected-content previews with post links and context snippets.
  • Per-tag and per-post cleanup with WordPress revisions.
  • Preserve-content and remove-content cleanup modes.
  • Reversible frontend suppression for selected tags.
  • Ignore and whitelist rules for false positives.
  • No telemetry and no external service dependency.

Pro add-on

The separately distributed Kitawolf Unregistered Tag Cleanup Pro plugin adds CSV and JSON reports, multi-select result controls, bulk suppression, and bulk ignore workflows. The Pro code is not included in this WordPress.org plugin.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the kitawolf-unregistered-tag-cleanup directory to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate Kitawolf Unregistered Tag Cleanup through the Plugins screen.
  3. Open Tools > Unregistered Tag Cleanup.
  4. Run a scan and review every result before applying cleanup actions.
sections.faq:
Does the free plugin limit scans or cleanup?

No. All manual scanning, preview, suppression, ignore, and cleanup features are available without quotas.

Does cleanup create revisions?

Yes. Content changes use WordPress’s post update API so supported post types can retain revisions according to the site’s normal revision settings.

Is suppression destructive?

No. Suppression filters selected unregistered shortcode tags on display and leaves stored post content unchanged. It is disabled by default.
